metadata.title: Micron Stock Drops.  Memory Price Warnings Pile Up After Democrat Success.<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Micron Stock Faces a Memory Price Conundrum in the Wake of Democrat Success
Micron Technology stock was being pressured Wednesday as the market assesses the future of the artificial-intelligence trade following a wave of Democrat victories in midterm elections. Strong results from Advanced Micro Devices weren’t enough to offset those concerns.
